matches.rationale: GT1 concerns Equation (3) in the Method section, which presents an invalid decomposition mixing summation and concatenation notation. Finding 1 addresses cross-attention scaling in different equations (5-6 vs 14-15), not the update decomposition mechanism in Equation (3).

GT2 identifies that cross-attention equations in Section 2.2.2 incorrectly use sqrt(N_t) instead of sqrt(d) for scaling. Finding 1 detects exactly this issue by noting the inconsistency between main text equations using sqrt(d) and Appendix B using sqrt(N_t), correctly identifying that sequence length should not be used for attention scaling.

GT3 concerns Equation (13) where the cross-modal adaptation term inconsistently applies matrix B to zero vectors for text tokens. Finding 1 addresses attention scaling factors in different equations, not the matrix B application consistency issue in Equation (13).

pred_verdicts.rationale: Correctly detects GT2's attention scaling error using N_t instead of d.
